plainText:
Ryuki (Japanese: リュウキ Ryūki) is a non-player character in the Generation VII . He is a rock guitarist and a Pokémon Trainer who specializes in .

==In the core series games==
Ryuki is a rock musician who has traveled to Alola from another region beyond the sea in order to spread his fame. He is one of the s who can challenge the for the title of Pokémon Champion in rematches in Pokémon Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun, and Ultra Moon.

In Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon, Ryuki also sometimes appears at the Kantonian Gym in Malie City, where he can be battled, although defeating him is not necessary to complete the Kantonian Gym challenge. After being defeated for the first time, he gives the player a Dragon Scale. He also promises to become a Gym Leader once real Gyms start appearing in Alola.

===Pokémon===
Ryuki's Pokémon are kept in Ultra Balls.

==In animation==
 
Ryuki appeared in Aiming for the Top Floor! as the leader of the Kantonian Gym. He first had a with , easily defeating his when it became distracted by Ryuki's music. Next, he battled , but when was losing to Ryuki's , became infuriated and ate some of the decorations on Ryuki's suit in retaliation. Ryuki then changed the match into a Double Battle, with Ash using Rowlet and Meltan against Ryuki's and Zweilous. Thanks to Rowlet learning , Ash was able to win the match. Ryuki then gave him a Badge bearing a picture of his own face as a proof of his victory.

===Character===
Ryuki considers himself a star, and his stage persona tends to take over the battlefield. He tends to shout into his microphone to ensure that he gets his way. He insists on being called "Leader", as he feels anything less disregards his individuality and undermines his authority.

===Pokémon Adventures===
Ryuki debuted in Shock!! Father in the Pendant!. He considers himself a battling superstar, so he traveled to Alola in hopes of fighting the powerful Ultra Beasts. He was hired by Faba, who agreed to help Ryuki in exchange for his services. Ryuki was sent to Mount Lanakila, where he found lying unconscious in the snow after she returned to Alola via an Ultra Wormhole. He picked the girl up and took her to Aether Paradise, where Faba had her locked in a cell.

Moon was later freed by Gladion, who teamed up with her to stop Faba. Cornered, Faba tricked Ryuki into helping him by revealing Gladion's Silvally was created to defeat the Ultra Beasts. This subsequently prompted Ryuki to battle Gladion and Moon in order to defend his place in the spotlight. After losing his first Pokémon, Ryuki sent out two more, only for Gladion to stop him and call off the battle, revealing Faba was using it as a distraction so he could flee Aether Paradise. After learning that others were fighting the Ultra Beasts elsewhere in Alola, Ryuki ran off to join them.

Months later, Gladion and Dulse set off to rescue Faba, who had been dragged into Ultra Space by several . Ryuki chose to accompany them, much to Gladion's annoyance.

==Trivia==
In Pokémon Masters EX, mentions that, in addition to Alola, he has also visited Johto and Unova.
